The Problem

Student onboarding buried staff in paperwork

Every new student enrollment triggered a cascade of manual tasks — creating folders, generating documents, filling templates, ensuring compliance with SEND Code of Practice and the Equality Act 2010. Staff spent hours on administrative work instead of supporting students. This system does it all in seconds.

How It Works

From form submission to complete documentation

The entire flow is triggered by a single Microsoft Forms submission — everything else is automatic.

1

Form Trigger & Data Collection

A Microsoft Forms submission triggers the Power Automate flow instantly. The form captures 49 field values — student details, educational needs, support requirements, and compliance data — all in approximately 2 seconds.

2

SharePoint Structure Creation

The flow creates a master student folder in SharePoint with 5 organized subfolders: Enrolment, Job Packet, One Plan, Risk Assessment, and SEND. Every student gets the same consistent structure, automatically.

3

AI Document Generation

Parallel child flows use AI Gen to populate a 62-field "One Plan" document and a 107-field "Risk Assessment" template. The AI interprets the form data and writes appropriate, professional content for each field.

4

Compliance & Filing

All generated documents are verified for compliance with SEND Code of Practice and Equality Act 2010, then filed into the correct SharePoint subfolders — ready for staff review without any manual intervention.
